terms.title: Before you book
terms.intro: A video reading is a 30-minute one-to-one session over video, from wherever you feel comfortable. I work with mediumship, tarot and angel cards, and the reading follows whatever spirit brings forward: messages from loved ones, guidance on what you're going through, or both.
needs: A quiet, private space where you won't be interrupted
A phone, tablet or computer with a camera and sound, and a stable internet connection
An open mind. Questions are welcome, or you can let the reading unfold
terms: You must be 18 or over to book.
I can't guarantee who will come through or what will be said. Spirit decides who steps forward.
Readings are for guidance and comfort. They're not a substitute for medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.
Payment is taken in full when you book.
Changes and refunds: any booking can be transferred to another slot with at least 24 hours' notice. If you cancel with less notice than that, I may not be able to transfer your booking.
terms.privacy_note: The booking calendar is provided by Calendly, which will ask before setting its own cookies.
terms.agree_label: I'm 18 or over, and I've read and understood the above.
